proposed.text: How should an architect select an MDPE multiplier for a project with innovative design and high regulatory complexity, per SPP 202 Sec 5.2?

options.text: Select a multiplier within the source-backed 1.5-2.5 range, moving higher for greater overhead, experience, or complexity; SPP 202 lists qualitative factors and does not publish add-on amounts
Add 0.1-0.3 for innovation and 0.1-0.2 for regulatory complexity to the base multiplier
Use a fixed multiplier of 2.8 for all innovative projects
Always use the lowest multiplier (1.5) regardless of complexity, to stay competitive

proposed.rationale: SPP Document 202, Section 5.2 states the MDPE multiplier ranges from 1.5 to 2.5 and lists only qualitative factors (office setup, overhead, the Architect's experience, project complexity). It does NOT publish a +0.1-0.3 innovation adjustment, a +0.1-0.2 regulatory adjustment, or any fixed add-on schedule. Such add-ons are exam traps. Source: SPP 202 Sec 5.2 (https://www.architectureboard.com.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/09/1.4-2010-SPP-for-PH-Architects.pdf).
proposed.explanation: SPP 202 Sec 5.2 supports only the 1.5-2.5 multiplier range and qualitative factors. Any numerical add-on schedule for innovation or regulatory complexity is invented.
